key_idea: The minimum-variance subset of size k is a contiguous window of the sorted array; evaluate each window with prefix sums.
sketch: Sort, build prefix sums of x and x^2, and for every window compute sum of squared deviations = Q - S^2/k. To avoid cancellation (Q up to 5e17, S^2 up to 2.5e23) compute k*Q - S^2 exactly in __int128, take the minimum, and divide by k at the end. O(n log n). Pitfall is doing the subtraction in doubles, which loses the required precision.
